run_normalize_text: run the normalize_text script to clean text from stdin by removing special characters
run_text_normalization: run the normalize_text script to strip non-alphanumeric characters and normalize whitespace from input
run_filter_text: run the normalize_text script to filter text keeping only letters numbers marks apostrophes and hyphens
run_clean_transcript: run the normalize_text script to clean wav2vec transcript text by removing punctuation and extra spaces
run_preprocess_text: run the normalize_text script to preprocess text lines by removing unicode special characters and normalizing
